description.value: Pretraining of EquiformerV2 (medium variant, 86.6M parameters) on the OMat24 dataset comprising over 110M DFT calculations across diverse inorganic materials. The model is trained to predict energy, forces, and stress given an input structure, using per-atom MAE loss for energy, l2 norm loss for forces, and decomposed MAE loss for stress tensor components.

description.value: Pretraining of EquiformerV2 on OMat24 followed by fine-tuning on a combination of MPtrj and subsampled Alexandria (sAlexandria) datasets. This OAM (OMat24 + MPtrj/sAlex) strategy produces the highest performing models on the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, with eqV2-M achieving F1 score of 0.917 and energy-above-hull MAE of 20 meV/atom.
